headline: Ministry of Finance focuses on implementing many important tasks, aiming for double-digit growth
summary: Under Government Resolution No. 216 from the July 2026 regular session, the Ministry of Finance has been assigned several tasks. They aim to support economic development and the goal of double-digit growth in 2026.
why: Government growth targets and fiscal tasks shape spending, policy and sentiment for investors in Vietnam's economy.
